title: DMC3 HD Resource VFS Lookup Policy — Phase 14

records.title: Six resource namespace prefixes and order
records.summary: The canonical executable stores six fixed resource namespace prefix pointers in this exact order: GDataX360.afs/, GData.afs/, Video/, afs/sound/, SAVEDATA/, and the empty prefix.

locations.note: Six qword pointers in search order. The strings themselves reside elsewhere in the image.

records.title: OpenGameResource VFS basename and 12-attempt order
records.summary: In the evidenced VFS branch, OpenGameResource strips directory components at the last slash or backslash, then tries the six namespace prefixes twice. Pass 0 calls the mount resolver with provider mask 1; pass 1 uses provider mask 2. Candidate construction uses a 0x400-byte destination bound.

locations.note: VA 0x14002FCA0. Backward scan checks both 0x5C and 0x2F, then nested loops perform 2 x 6 calls to 0x140327430.

records.title: VFS provider masks select archive then physical providers
records.summary: The mount resolver walks the linked mount list. Archive mounts (type 1) are skipped when provider-mask bit 2 is set; physical mounts (type 0) are skipped when bit 1 is set. Therefore mask 1 is archive-only and mask 2 is physical-only for the OpenGameResource two-pass search.

locations.note: VA 0x140327430. Archive branch tests mask bit 2; physical branch tests mask bit 1.
